messages:
people-ops-bot: Heads-up — Luna's birthday is next Friday (May 6). Quick poll: react with :one: postcard + team messages, :two: small care package shipped, or :three: office tea & biscotti at 4pm. Reply with prefs or dietary/allergy notes.
harriet (People Ops): We can also do postcard + one small token (e.g., a plant or mug) for people in-office. If you pick shipping, please DM your address. Deadline Wed noon so I can order.
luna: you guys are too kind! honestly postcard + no big fuss is perfect.
evan: :one: postcard — I'll add a silly doodle. Also can someone remind me if Luna prefers coffee or tea?
priya: :two: care package please — I can curate tea + snacks (all GF). Luna, what's your vibe?
luna: tea over coffee, and low-sugar snacks if possible. also allergic to sesame, pls avoid.
sam: :three: if folks are in-office, i can bring biscotti (nut-free). otherwise :one: works.
noor: sending a little plant sounds cute if we're in-office. :seedling: happy to water it between plantsitters.
harriet (People Ops): noted: avoid sesame, low sugar, nut-free options flagged. Sign-up form: https://forms.gle/luna-bday-poll — pick 1/2/3, dietary notes, and whether you'll add a note to the postcard.
evan: I'll sign up to draw. can we add a tiny caption like "from your Redwood pals"?
luna: perfect, thank you!! small handwritten notes always make my day. :heart:
harriet (People Ops): Event placeholder created: "Luna birthday — postcard & treats". I'll pull addresses for shipping on Thu if option 2 wins. Final reminder: no balloons (latex allergy noted previously).
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: fill form by Wed 12:00 PT. Calendar invite will be sent if option 3 wins.
priya: volunteer to assemble care packages if needed. happy to source GF biscotti alternative.
sam: i'll bring disposable cups and stash of honey packets (sugar-free option).
harriet (People Ops): Thanks all — please keep replies short so we don't spam the channel. I'll post results after the poll closes and DM next steps.
